cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.2.3.0)
project(CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE C)
set_property(DIRECTORY PROPERTY INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "")
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE 1)
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "-march=nocona -mtune=haswell -ftree-vectorize -fPIC -fstack-protector-strong -fno-plt -O2 -ffunction-sections -isystem /home/isaacp/miniforge3/envs/ros2_jazzy_env/include")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} ${COMPILE_DEFINITIONS}")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG "-g")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "-Wl,-O2 -Wl,--sort-common -Wl,--as-needed -Wl,-z,relro -Wl,-z,now -Wl,--disable-new-dtags -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,--allow-shlib-undefined -Wl,-rpath,/home/isaacp/miniforge3/envs/ros2_jazzy_env/lib -Wl,-rpath-link,/home/isaacp/miniforge3/envs/ros2_jazzy_env/lib -L/home/isaacp/miniforge3/envs/ros2_jazzy_env/lib")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} ${EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}")
include_directories(${INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
set(CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION 1)
link_directories(${LINK_DIRECTORIES})
add_definitions([==[-v]==])
cmake_policy(SET CMP0083 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0155 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0157 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0181 OLD)
include("${CMAKE_ROOT}/Modules/Internal/HeaderpadWorkaround.cmake")
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "/home/isaacp/repos/alphaz/isaac_ros_cloud_control/build/isaac_ros_cloud_control_interface/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-KoGqL3")
add_executable(cmTC_9ce75)
target_sources(cmTC_9ce75 PRIVATE
  "/home/isaacp/miniforge3/envs/ros2_jazzy_env/share/cmake-4.2/Modules/CMakeCCompilerABI.c"
)
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cmTC_9ce75_loc"
     CONTENT $<TARGET_FILE:cmTC_9ce75>)
target_link_libraries(cmTC_9ce75 ${LINK_LIBRARIES})
